source_separation: All dates, wording, and compound combinations are absent from v1 development and holdout files.
reporting_rule: Report raw GoalSpec or raw direct-tool output, compiled DAG, executed result, all three valid sampling seeds, retries, tokens, P50/P95 latency, peak GPU memory, Slurm resources, hashes, and failures separately.
promotion_rule: Every candidate threshold must pass; otherwise the Singapore loopback service remains deterministic. Passing permits a loopback gate only and does not enable a public or production model planner.
